city_vars.market_blurb: Lufkin, Texas serves as a key economic hub for East Texas, historically anchored by the timber and forestry industry due to its location in the Pineywoods region. The city's economy has diversified over time to include manufacturing—particularly oilfield equipment through companies like Lufkin Industries—along with healthcare and retail trade serving surrounding rural counties. As the largest city in Angelina County, Lufkin functions as a regional commercial and medical center.
city_vars.local_note: Lufkin's water supply, drawn largely from groundwater sources, tends to be moderately hard, which can contribute to mineral buildup in water heaters, dishwashers, and washing machines over time. The region experiences frequent severe thunderstorms and occasional tropical storm remnants from the Gulf, leading to periodic power surges and outages that can stress appliance electronics and compressors.
city_vars.city_spotlight:
Lufkin sits at the heart of the Piney Woods, serving as the commercial anchor for Deep East Texas and the seat of Angelina County. The surrounding forests built the city's original economy, and timber and wood products manufacturing still run deep in its identity, though the modern base has broadened considerably. Lufkin Industries' oil field equipment work, alongside healthcare, education, retail, and government offices, now gives the local economy a sturdier, more diverse footing than its lumber-town roots alone.

With roughly 34,000 residents, Lufkin feels sized just right — big enough for full-service hospitals, a community college, and steady employers, yet small enough that neighborhoods like Crown Colony and Kurth still carry a distinct, close-knit character. It's a working city, proud of its piney landscape and its role as the region's steady hub.

columns.heading: Freezer Not Freezing
columns.text: A freezer not reaching proper temperature often stems from a faulty thermostat, refrigerant leak, or compressor failure. Wells Appliance Repair technicians diagnose the root cause and restore freezing performance.

columns.heading: Ice Buildup Inside
columns.text: Excessive frost and ice accumulation usually indicate a defrost cycle malfunction or a worn door seal allowing warm air inside. Our technicians identify and repair the underlying issue quickly.

columns.heading: Leaking Water
columns.text: Water pooling under or around your freezer typically points to a blocked drain line, frozen defrost drain, or damaged drain pan. Wells Appliance Repair clears obstructions and replaces worn components as needed.

columns.heading: Loud or Unusual Noises
columns.text: Strange sounds—clicking, buzzing, or humming—often signal issues with the compressor, fan motor, or expansion valve. Our technicians in Lufkin diagnose noisy freezers and restore quiet operation.

columns.heading: Compressor Won't Run
columns.text: When the compressor fails to start, electrical issues, a faulty start relay, or internal compressor problems are common culprits. Wells Appliance Repair tests and repairs or replaces the compressor and related parts.

columns.heading: Door Seal Not Sealing
columns.text: A broken or warped door gasket allows cold air to escape, causing temperature loss and higher energy bills. Our technicians replace worn seals to restore an airtight fit on your upright or chest freezer.

fq_items.question: How do I prevent Viking freezer problems from happening again?
fq_items.answer: Keep the door seals clean and replace them if cracked; maintain proper airflow around and inside the freezer; avoid overloading; and keep the condenser coils dust-free. Regular gentle maintenance reduces strain on the compressor. Our technician can also point out any habits or conditions during your repair that might help you avoid future breakdowns.
